notes.title: Update 1.72
notes.notes:
Hello!
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38150975/f4dc07a5b3a56405c9f2fa8e6d77200ae9148228.png
Added a weapon selection wheel. By default, it is called up by the Tab key, but it works quite well if you set it to the middle mouse button or any other key (If you have a multi-button mouse, the game supports up to 6 mouse buttons). No more reaching for distant keys or scrolling through the list of weapons with the mouse wheel. I hope that the presence of a weapon selection wheel will have a positive effect on the rhythm of the game.
To select a weapon, you need to press Tab and move the mouse towards the desired weapon, then release Tab.

notes.title: Update 1.71
notes.notes:
Hello everyone!

Added support for panini perspective.
This option allows you to reduce perspective distortions on the screen edges at high camera angles. 

The effect only works correctly at high FOV values ​​(110+)
Unfortunately, since this is a post-effect of distortion of the existing image, after its application directly in the area of ​​the center of the screen there will be a reduced resolution, approximately twice. [spoiler]I will probably return to this if I find time to solve the problem of increasing the resolution more than the maximum screen resolution. [/spoiler] ːarmoredheadː

notes.title: Update 1.687 Fixes
notes.notes:
Hi everyone!

 Fixed a bug where the wave could end, and several opponents could remain in the arena
 Optimization
 Added arena images to the menu
 Minor changes to the main arena
 The climbing system has been improved, now to climb you only need to hold down the "Forward" key. Fixed erroneous climbing on doors and other elements of the arena. Now it’s easy to get out of the lava if you accidentally fall, you just need to move towards the threshold.
 Boxes and barrels are picked up from the floor automatically [spoiler](optional)[/spoiler]. The throwing force has become much greater. Tests have shown that during intense combat, players absolutely do not have enough time and attention to aim and press the action button. It turned out that it was much more fun to lift boxes and barrels automatically and launch them at enemies. The dynamics of the game increase, giving more freedom to the players.
 The robot pill wheel no longer disappears into the floor


 Updated lava and enemy interactions with it. Some robots with low HP, while chasing you, can fall into lava and burn. Rams generally follow you everywhere, [spoiler]so you can lure them into the lava.[/spoiler]
